class.name: SVG3D
class.brief_description: Renders SVG markup on a sprite in a 3D scene.
class.description: SVG3D rasterizes SVG markup into the inherited [member Sprite3D.texture]. Use [member SpriteBase3D.pixel_size] to control its size in 3D space.

members.member: The rasterized image size in pixels. Set both components above zero to override the SVG document size. [code]Vector2.ZERO[/code] uses the document size. Change [member SpriteBase3D.pixel_size] to scale the sprite in 3D space.
The complete SVG markup to render on the 3D sprite. Load an SVG file as text and assign its contents here.
